units.summary: Adds an isolation method that returns the highest appendID guaranteed to be committed. It returns the last issued ID when no appenders are open, and the lowest open ID minus one otherwise. compactHeadViewLocked uses it as the eviction watermark, so a wrong value could evict series whose newest samples are in no block.
units.headline: Add committedAppendID returning highest guaranteed-committed append ID
units.reason: New concurrency-sensitive watermark that decides whether series are evicted from the head, so a mistake can lose data.
focus: open appender list is ordered by ascending appendID so next is the lowest open ID
sentinel appendID really holds the last issued ID when the list is empty
RLock gives a consistent view against newAppendID and closeAppend

units.summary: Adds a table of subtests for committedAppendID covering disabled isolation, no appenders, all closed, one open, several open appenders closed in different orders, and open reads. It only adds coverage and does not change production behavior.
units.headline: Add tests pinning committedAppendID semantics
units.reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior.
